synthesis:draft.headline: Operational demand: the regional “as generated” demand used for operational reporting and forecasting.
summary: Operational demand in a region is the demand met by scheduled, semi-scheduled and significant non-scheduled generation, by generation from scheduled bidirectional units, and by generation imports to the region, excluding the demand of local scheduled loads and scheduled bidirectional units, and including Wholesale Demand Response [c1].
Operational demand generally excludes demand met by non-scheduled wind/solar generation of aggregate capacity < 30 MW, non-scheduled non-wind/non-solar generation and exempt generation [c2].
Actual operational demand includes the measured operational demand reconstituted with estimated actual Wholesale Demand Response (WDR) [c3].
AEMO uses operational demand for public reporting (for example minimum and maximum measured operational demand records reported to the media) and in pre-dispatch and PASA forecasting processes [c4].
AEMO publishes Operational Demand (Actual and Forecast) CSV files as part of the EMMS data model website publication [c5].
